extraction.Name: William Grant
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent issued without a request therefor. Superintendent E. E. McKean forwarded affidavit of William Grant on July 8, 1929, requesting it be added to a former report sent June 22nd covering similar cases. Clement Valandra is mentioned in Grant's affidavit; Valandra is a Rosebud Indian with nothing with which to settle any damages that might be assessed against him and has many other claims against him.
